Exact 4:3 landscape, 1448 x 1086. Preserve ALL meaningful written contents from the input: the computer must show the fully populated Monthly Budget spreadsheet with Category, Budget, Actual, Difference columns, dollar amounts, labeled pie chart and Spending Overview bar chart; notebook must show written Monthly Budget amounts and Goals; envelopes must have their budget category labels. Papers, graphs, documents and computer screens MUST have writing and data, NEVER empty tables, blank graphs or placeholder interfaces. Change only decorative lettering on the ceramic mug and decorative motto on the green notebook cover to plain surfaces. Keep books, candle, calculator, cash savings jar, and natural lighting. All people remain unchanged in identity. No cropped head, no bars, no collage strips, no distortion, no invented words on walls or cups.
